title: v4.9.1 Adviser Comparison Matrix
notes: Adviser proposal list now offers a comparison matrix with selectable groups and proposal parts, full entries in 14 px text, and chain-link source-task links
Tools now offers separate Researcher and Adviser workspaces
Advisers can import several JSON backups as independent read-only review copies and open each in its own tab
Adviser imports preserve personal reflections and contribution records included in the file; researcher drafts are kept separate
Open New Version uses a fresh address; online page loads and service-worker update checks bypass the browser HTTP cache
Compare all three shows definitions of three terms across quantitative, qualitative and mixed methods, with a stacked layout on small screens
Definition of Terms now guides term selection and offers quantitative, qualitative and mixed-methods examples and templates
Literature meaning and measurement details are optional; previews and exports list each term followed by its definition
Study Design tasks now offer quantitative, qualitative and mixed-methods worked examples and writing templates in pop-ups
Framework examples identify original authors and link to verified publications
The HNU ERB Protocol Packet can be downloaded from Tools and Ethical Considerations
Ethical Considerations now includes an ERB protocol profile, document checklist, and preparation summary
Consent-document preparation now prompts for access, data sharing or future use, opt-out, and local-language planning
ERB reviewer-only forms are clearly kept outside student tasks
Offline access and local-only proposal storage remain unchanged
